subject: Make valkey-server --help/-h output to stdout and exit with 0 (#2296)
reason: The change affects only the valkey-server --help/-h code path: usage() in src/server.c is called solely from the argv[1] == --help/-h branch of main() (server.c:7099), and now prints to stdout and exits 0 instead of stderr/1. No running server, tool behaviour, reply, replication, or persistence path is touched, so no deployment-based experiment can reach it. The only way to exercise it is to run `valkey-server --help` as a process and compare exit status and stdout/stderr across builds, but no installed component can do that: valkey.action.tools is limited by its schema to valkey-cli, valkey-b
